headline: Alexei Ratmansky Stages a Ballet in Kyiv, Between Trips to the Bomb Shelter
context: The choreographer Alexei Ratmansky and his wife, Tatiana, returned to the national ballet company at a bleak moment, bringing the gift of a difficult, sparkling work.
